title: gmaio comparison-reads samplesheet
description: One row per external comparison sample. These reads are QC'd/host-removed the same way as regular samples, then mapped against the final dereplicated bin representatives (and, for illumina_metagenome, the gene catalogue) for comparison purposes -- they are never assembled or binned. illumina_metagenome reads fastq_1 + fastq_2; nanopore_metagenome reads long_reads. Sample IDs must not collide with the main samplesheet's sample IDs.

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and contain no spaces

fastq_1.errorMessage: fastq_1 must be a path to a gzipped FASTQ (.fastq.gz / .fq.gz)

fastq_2.errorMessage: fastq_2 must be a path to a gzipped FASTQ (.fastq.gz / .fq.gz)

long_reads.errorMessage: long_reads must be a path to a gzipped FASTQ (.fastq.gz / .fq.gz)

items.errorMessage: Each comparison sample needs fastq_1 + fastq_2 (illumina_metagenome) or long_reads (nanopore_metagenome)
